b2-mexiconorte-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Up into the Sierra
b2-mexiconorte-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are planning a trip to the Barrancas del Cobre and reading about the region in Budapest.
b2-mexiconorte-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what happens to the climate as you go up into the mountains.
cues: Use a connector for a gradual change
b2-mexiconorte-01.target: Conforme se sube a la sierra, el clima cambia.
b2-mexiconorte-01.english: As you go up into the mountains, the climate changes.
b2-mexiconorte-01.canDo: I can use conforme to say that something changes little by little, as in Conforme se sube a la sierra, el clima cambia.

b2-mexiconorte-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Vaqueros' Day
b2-mexiconorte-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You are telling Meg what you read in an article about vaqueros in northern Mexico.
b2-mexiconorte-02.prompt: Tell Meg that the days of work were hard, with the quality first.
cues: Say whose days of work they were
b2-mexiconorte-02.target: Duros eran los días de trabajo.
b2-mexiconorte-02.english: Hard were the days of work.
b2-mexiconorte-02.canDo: I can put a quality or a place first, as in Duros eran los días de trabajo, to stress it when I describe vaquero life.

b2-mexiconorte-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Water for Monterrey
b2-mexiconorte-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are preparing a talk in Budapest about Monterrey and its water problem, and Carlos asks what could help.
b2-mexiconorte-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what would happen if Monterrey could reuse more water.
cues: Start with a condition that is only imagined
Say that the pressure would be less
b2-mexiconorte-03.target: Si Monterrey pudiera reutilizar más agua, la presión sería menor.
b2-mexiconorte-03.english: If Monterrey could reuse more water, the pressure would be less.
b2-mexiconorte-03.canDo: I can use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional to say what would happen if something were different in Monterrey.

b2-mexiconorte-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Corrido
b2-mexiconorte-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about the Mexican border in Budapest, and a corrido is playing.
b2-mexiconorte-04.prompt: Tell Meg what a corrido is, with a relative clause.
cues: Say that it is a song
Say what is told in it
b2-mexiconorte-04.target: El corrido es una canción en la que se cuentan historias de migrantes.
b2-mexiconorte-04.english: The corrido is a song in which stories of migrants are told.
b2-mexiconorte-04.canDo: I can use a preposition + el que / la que / los que / las que to describe places, songs and people on the border.

b2-mexiconorte-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Made in the North
b2-mexiconorte-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are reading an article about the factories of northern Mexico, and Carlos asks what they make.
b2-mexiconorte-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what is made in the north.
cues: Use se and a plural verb
b2-mexiconorte-05.target: En el norte se fabrican vehículos y aparatos electrónicos.
b2-mexiconorte-05.english: In the north vehicles and electronic devices are made.
b2-mexiconorte-05.canDo: I can use se + a third-person verb to say what is made, exported or agreed in the north, as in Se fabrican vehículos.

b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The North and Its Water
b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You are giving a short talk in Budapest about northern Mexico, and you reach the problem of water.
b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.prompt: Tell your listeners how the cities of the north are changing and what worries people.
cues: Use a connector for a gradual change
b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.target: Conforme crecen las ciudades del norte, la falta de agua preocupa más.
b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.english: As the cities of the north grow, the lack of water causes more concern.
b2-mexiconorte-consolidation.canDo: I can recall the main facts about northern Mexico: the deserts and canyons, vaquero culture, Monterrey, the border and the factories.
